heavy_hammer.name: Meteor Hammer
heavy_hammer.description: A brutal chunk of iron on a handle. Crushes armor and finesse alike.

twin_maces.name: Twin Iron Maces
twin_maces.description: A pair of short maces used in tandem. Their rhythm disorients opponents trained for single weapons.

thunder_war_hammer.name: Thunder War Hammer
thunder_war_hammer.description: An enormous two-handed iron hammer. Said to replicate the force of a thunderbolt with every downswing.
